1477-5034-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-5034-5660-6769.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sol Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

184-4682-6441.easyPrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
184-4682-6441.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-4682-6441.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least six Treasure tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

512-2872-5724.easyPrerequisites: Sage of the Maze and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
512-2872-5724.description:
Activate Sage of the Maze by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Sage of the Maze, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

1339-1832-4050-5708.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-5708.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

628-3899--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3384-3899-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.

Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1228-3899-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
1228-3899-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat from step 2.

Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Gruul Turf.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Gruul Turf from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

3682-4574-4659-5283-6842.notablePrerequisites:
There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
3682-4574-4659-5283-6842.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Inexorable Tide triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mox Amber, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mox Amber from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mox Amber.
Repeat.

129-1409-3499-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-3043-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-7175.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

713-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

2463-3259-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

751-3755-7165.description:
Activate Pristine Angel by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Pristine Angel triggers, untapping it.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2440-3581-4927-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-4927-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

3334-6575-6774--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Loading Zone and Lae'zel, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1978-2750-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least three.
1978-2750-3291.description:
Cause Karametra's Acolyte to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat from step 2.

4364-5658-6960.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block or kill Satya.
4364-5658-6960.description:
Declare Aurelia and Satya as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Satya trigger, creating a token copy of Long River Lurker and causing you to get {E}{E}.
When the Long River Lurker token enters, it triggers, targeting Aurelia.
Resolve the Aurelia trigger from step 1, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Aurelia, triggering the Long River Lurker token, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat each combat phase.

522-1477-2111.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

2957-4094-4508-5880.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

280-654-5449-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-654-5449-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2440-2703-5295.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

345-4659-5003-6554.manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
345-4659-5003-6554.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

440-1339-1786-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1786-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Queza trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Queza trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2104-2556-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2104-2556-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2511-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

955-1069-1256-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
955-1069-1256-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

803-5231-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
803-5231-5853.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
803-5231-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Snail, adding {R}.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

4727-5779.description:
All nonwhite creatures your opponents control will have base toughness 0, and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness unless there is another effect increasing its toughness.
Whenever a nonwhite creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control, it will have base toughness 0, and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness unless there is another effect increasing its toughness.

Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 1 until Workhorse does not have any +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Workhorse's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
"Phyrexian" chosen with Conspiracy.

When the creature entes the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Conspiracy, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste or a 3/1 Dog creature token with vigilance.
Repeat step 2.

Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling an instant or sorcery at random from your graveyard, and casting a copy of Time Warp without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1722-2835-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Fecundity, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

2585-3430.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {9}.
Activate Grim Monolith's last ability by paying {4}, untapping it.
Repeat.
